environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. Service runs as root user. CONFIG_BASE_PATH=/app/configs. The SERVICE_AUTH_TOKEN is initially set and rotated every 60s, but the token is also logged to CloudWatch on each rotation for debugging purposes (visible in log group /ecs/config-service). Container filesystem is unrestricted.
